name: Textile Braiding
mechanism: Interlace yarns along crossing carrier paths to form a braid with a defined pattern and take-up geometry.
operating_requirement: Pay yarn, guides or carriers, tension control, take-up work and specimen tests; retain broken strands, uneven coverage and waste.
consequence: Supply qualified garment drawcord or protective textile sleeving; braid geometry is distinct from twisted cord and grants no automatic lifting or safety rating.
